30  class ApprovalReconciliationService:
   31      def __init__(
   32          self,
   33          session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession],
   34          *,
   35          checkpoint_probe: CheckpointProbe | None = None,
   36          resume_dispatch=None,
   37      ) -> None:
   38          self.session_factory = session_factory
   39          self.checkpoint_probe = checkpoint_probe
   40          self.resume_dispatch = resume_dispatch
   41  
   42      async def reconcile_run(
   43          self,
   44          context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
   45          run_id: UUID,
   46          *,
   47          checkpoint_exists: bool | None = None,
   48      ) -> AgentRun:
   49          if "agent_run" not in context.permissions:
   50              raise AgentHubError("FORBIDDEN", "You do not have permission.", 403)
   51          if checkpoint_exists is None:
   52              if self.checkpoint_probe is None:
   53                  raise AgentHubError(
   54                      "CHECKPOINT_PROBE_NOT_CONFIGURED",
   55                      "Checkpoint reconciliation is not configured.",
   56                      503,
   57                  )
   58              checkpoint_exists = await self.checkpoint_probe.has_checkpoint(
   59                  context.workspace_id, run_id
   60              )
   61          async with self.session_factory() as session:
   62              run = await session.scalar(
   63                  select(AgentRun)
   64                  .where(AgentRun.workspace_id == UUID(context.workspace_id), AgentRun.id == run_id)
   65                  .with_for_update()
   66              )
   67              if run is None:
   68                  raise AgentHubError("AGENT_RUN_NOT_FOUND", "The agent run was not found.", 404)
   69              approvals = list(
   70                  await session.scalars(
   71                      select(Approval).where(
   72                          Approval.workspace_id == UUID(context.workspace_id),
   73                          Approval.run_id == run_id,
   74                      )
   75                  )
   76              )
   77              pending = [
   78                  approval
   79                  for approval in approvals
   80                  if approval.decision_status == ApprovalDecisionStatus.PENDING
   81              ]
   82              before_status = run.status
   83              before_failure_code = run.failure_code
   84              before_completed_at = run.completed_at
   85              now = datetime.now(UTC)
   86              expired_count = 0
   87              for approval in pending:
   88                  if approval.expires_at is not None and approval.expires_at <= now:
   89                      approval.decision_status = ApprovalDecisionStatus.EXPIRED
   90                      approval.decided_at = now
   91                      expired_count += 1
   92              pending = [
   93                  approval
   94                  for approval in pending
   95                  if approval.decision_status == ApprovalDecisionStatus.PENDING
   96              ]
   97              _apply_reconciliation_transition(
   98                  run,
   99                  pending,
  100                  checkpoint_exists,
  101                  approvals=approvals,
  102                  stale=_run_is_stale(run, now),
  103              )
  104              if run.status in {"NEEDS_ATTENTION", "CANCELLED"} and run.completed_at is None:
  105                  run.completed_at = now
  106              if (
  107                  (before_status, before_failure_code) != (run.status, run.failure_code)
  108                  or before_completed_at != run.completed_at
  109                  or expired_count
  110              ):
  111                  await _append_reconciliation_step(
  112                      session,
  113                      run,
  114                      old_status=before_status,
  115                      reason=_reconciliation_reason(run, expired_count),
  116                  )
  117              await session.commit()
  118              await session.refresh(run)
  119              return run
  120  
  121      async def reconcile_candidates(
  122          self,
  123          *,
  124          batch_size: int = 100,
  125          stale_after_seconds: int = 300,
  126      ) -> dict[str, int]:
  127          """Reconcile a bounded, tenant-scoped batch for the worker beat task."""
  128  
  129          if self.checkpoint_probe is None:
  130              raise AgentHubError(
  131                  "CHECKPOINT_PROBE_NOT_CONFIGURED",
  132                  "Checkpoint reconciliation is not configured.",
  133                  503,
  134              )
  135          cutoff = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(seconds=stale_after_seconds)
  136          async with self.session_factory() as session:
  137              candidates = list(
  138                  await session.scalars(
  139                      select(AgentRun)
  140                      .where(
  141                          AgentRun.status.in_(
  142                              {"RUNNING", "WAITING_APPROVAL", "CANCEL_REQUESTED", "NEEDS_ATTENTION"}
  143                          ),
  144                          AgentRun.started_at <= cutoff,
  145                      )
  146                      .order_by(
  147                          AgentRun.reconciled_at.asc().nullsfirst(), AgentRun.started_at, AgentRun.id
  148                      )
  149                      .limit(batch_size)
  150                      .with_for_update(skip_locked=True)
  151                  )
  152              )
  153              # Advance the cursor even when the checkpoint probe itself fails;
  154              # a permanently broken first page must not starve later runs.
  155              for candidate in candidates:
  156                  candidate.reconciled_at = datetime.now(UTC)
  157              await session.commit()
  158          result = {"scanned": len(candidates), "changed": 0, "errors": 0}
  159          for candidate in candidates:
  160              try:
  161                  exists = await self.checkpoint_probe.has_checkpoint(
  162                      candidate.workspace_id, candidate.id
  163                  )
  164                  async with self.session_factory() as session:
  165                      run = await session.scalar(
  166                          select(AgentRun)
  167                          .where(
  168                              AgentRun.workspace_id == candidate.workspace_id,
  169                              AgentRun.id == candidate.id,
  170                          )
  171                          .with_for_update()
  172                      )
  173                      if run is None:
  174                          continue
  175                      before = (run.status, run.failure_code)
  176                      approvals = list(
  177                          await session.scalars(
  178                              select(Approval).where(
  179                                  Approval.workspace_id == run.workspace_id,
  180                                  Approval.run_id == run.id,
  181                              )
  182                          )
  183                      )
  184                      pending = [
  185                          approval
  186                          for approval in approvals
  187                          if approval.decision_status == ApprovalDecisionStatus.PENDING
  188                      ]
  189                      before_status = run.status
  190                      before_completed_at = run.completed_at
  191                      now = datetime.now(UTC)
  192                      run.reconciled_at = now
  193                      expired_count = 0
  194                      for approval in pending:
  195                          if approval.expires_at is not None and approval.expires_at <= now:
  196                              approval.decision_status = ApprovalDecisionStatus.EXPIRED
  197                              approval.decided_at = now
  198                              expired_count += 1
  199                      pending = [
  200                          approval
  201                          for approval in pending
  202                          if approval.decision_status == ApprovalDecisionStatus.PENDING
  203                      ]
  204                      _apply_reconciliation_transition(
  205                          run,
  206                          pending,
  207                          exists,
  208                          approvals=approvals,
  209                          stale=_run_is_stale(run, now),

1  """The literature research template.
    2  
    3  A literature assistant that invents papers is worse than no literature
    4  assistant, so the prompt is the load-bearing part of this template. It is not,
    5  however, what makes fabrication impossible -- that is the provenance check in
    6  ``packages.artifacts.schemas``, which refuses to store a searched paper that
    7  cannot be traced back to a tool call. Prompts are advice; the validator is the
    8  rule.
    9  """
   10  
   11  from __future__ import annotations
   12  
   13  from packages.agent_templates.base import GROUNDING_RULES, THREAD_CONTEXT_RULES, AgentTemplate
   14  from packages.threads import kinds
   15  
   16  RESEARCH = "research"
   17  
   18  ANTI_FABRICATION_RULES = f"""\
   19  Rules you must follow without exception:
   20  
   21  {GROUNDING_RULES}
   22  - Every specific paper you recommend must come from a literature tool result
   23    in this turn. Never name a paper you have not just retrieved, and never write
   24    a title, DOI, author list, venue, year or citation count from memory.
   25  - In the conversation, explain what you searched for, why you searched that
   26    way, and how many results came back. Do not restate the list of papers --
   27    the list lives in the artifact beside the conversation."""
   28  
   29  RESEARCH_SYSTEM_PROMPT = f"""\
   30  You are a literature research assistant. You help the user find, filter and
   31  make sense of academic papers on a topic, across a conversation that may run
   32  for many turns.
   33  
   34  How you work:
   35  
   36  - Turn the user's question into a concrete search. Say what you are searching
   37    for before you search.
   38  - Use the literature tools for anything factual about a paper. Your own
   39    knowledge is useful for framing a search and for judging relevance; it is
   40    never a source for citations.
   41  - Narrow down rather than dumping results. When the user asks for a subset, say
   42    which subset you are after before you go and get it.
   43  {THREAD_CONTEXT_RULES}
   44  
   45  {ANTI_FABRICATION_RULES}
   46  """
   47  
   48  RESEARCH_TEMPLATE = AgentTemplate(
   49      key=RESEARCH,
   50      name="Research Assistant",
   51      description=(
   52          "Finds and filters academic papers through literature tools, and never cites from memory."
   53      ),
   54      system_prompt=RESEARCH_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
   55      tool_hints=("search_papers", "get_paper"),
   56      thread_kind=kinds.RESEARCH,
   57  )
   58  
   59  __all__ = [
   60      "ANTI_FABRICATION_RULES",
   61      "RESEARCH",
   62      "RESEARCH_SYSTEM_PROMPT",
   63      "RESEARCH_TEMPLATE",
   64  ]

   59  class DeterministicStreamAdapter:
   60      def __init__(self) -> None:
   61          self.calls: list[dict[str, object]] = []
   62          self.outcomes: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   63  
   64      async def stream(self, profile, credential, request) -> AsyncIterator[ModelStreamEvent]:
   65          del request
   66          self.calls.append(
   67              {
   68                  "model": profile.model,
   69                  "temperature": profile.temperature,
   70                  "max_tokens": profile.max_tokens,
   71                  "timeout_seconds": profile.timeout_seconds,
   72                  "capabilities": profile.capabilities,
   73                  "provider": credential.provider,
   74                  "secret": credential.secret,
   75              }
   76          )
   77          outcome = self.outcomes[profile.model].pop(0)
   78          if outcome == "pre-visible-error":
   79              raise ModelGatewayError(
   80                  ModelGatewayErrorCode.MODEL_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
   81                  retryable=True,
   82              )
   83          if outcome == "message-interrupted":
   84              yield ModelStreamEvent(
   85                  event_type=ModelStreamEventType.MESSAGE_DELTA,
   86                  message_delta="partial message",
   87              )
   88              raise ModelGatewayError(ModelGatewayErrorCode.MODEL_TIMEOUT, retryable=True)
   89          if outcome == "tool-interrupted":
   90              yield ModelStreamEvent(
   91                  event_type=ModelStreamEventType.TOOL_CALL_DELTA,
   92                  tool_call_delta=ModelToolCallDelta(index=0, name="lookup"),
   93              )
   94              raise ModelGatewayError(ModelGatewayErrorCode.MODEL_TIMEOUT, retryable=True)
   95          if outcome != "success":
   96              raise AssertionError(f"unsupported deterministic outcome: {outcome}")
   97          yield ModelStreamEvent(
   98              event_type=ModelStreamEventType.MESSAGE_DELTA,
   99              message_delta="complete message",
  100          )
  101          yield ModelStreamEvent(
  102              event_type=ModelStreamEventType.COMPLETED,
  103              response=ModelResponse(
  104                  content="complete message",
  105                  provider=credential.provider,
  106                  model=profile.model,
  107              ),
  108          )

  143          workspace_id=workspace_id,
  144          provider="provider-a",
  145          name="rotatable",
  146          secret="original-secret",
  147      )
  148      fallback = ModelProfile(
  149          id=uuid4(),
  150          workspace_id=workspace_id,
  151          provider_credential_id=credential.id,
  152          model="db-fallback-b",
  153          temperature=Decimal("0.1"),
  154          max_tokens=128,
  155          timeout_seconds=Decimal("10"),
  156          capabilities={"streaming": True, "max_context_tokens": 8192},
  157      )
  158      drifted_fallback = ModelProfile(
  159          id=uuid4(),
  160          workspace_id=workspace_id,
  161          provider_credential_id=credential.id,
  162          model="db-fallback-c",
  163          temperature=Decimal("0.1"),
  164          max_tokens=128,
  165          timeout_seconds=Decimal("10"),
  166          capabilities={"streaming": True, "max_context_tokens": 8192},
  167      )
  168      primary = ModelProfile(
  169          id=uuid4(),
  170          workspace_id=workspace_id,
  171          provider_credential_id=credential.id,
  172          model="db-primary-a",
  173          temperature=Decimal("0.1"),
  174          max_tokens=128,
  175          timeout_seconds=Decimal("10"),
  176          fallback_profile_id=fallback.id,
  177          capabilities={"streaming": True, "max_context_tokens": 8192},
  178      )

240      async def touch(self, *, workspace_id: UUID, memory_ids: tuple[UUID, ...]) -> None:
  241          """Record that these rows were actually injected somewhere.
  242  
  243          Separate from selection so that a read is a read. ``last_used_at`` is
  244          what makes decay defensible later: a memory nobody has needed in months
  245          is a different thing from a memory that was written months ago.
  246          """
  247  
  248          if not memory_ids:
  249              return
  250          async with self.session_factory() as session:
  251              await session.execute(
  252                  update(WorkspaceMemory)
  253                  .where(
  254                      WorkspaceMemory.workspace_id == workspace_id,
  255                      WorkspaceMemory.id.in_(memory_ids),
  256                  )
  257                  .values(last_used_at=datetime.now(UTC))
  258              )
  259              await session.commit()

251  def _apply_reconciliation_transition(
  252      run: AgentRun,
  253      pending: list[Approval],
  254      checkpoint_exists: bool,
  255      *,
  256      approvals: list[Approval] | None = None,
  257      stale: bool = False,
  258  ) -> None:
  259      all_approvals = approvals or pending
  260      before_status = run.status
  261      now = datetime.now(UTC)
  262      expiry = getattr(run, "execution_lease_expires_at", None)
  263      live_owner = bool(
  264          getattr(run, "execution_owner", None)
  265          and expiry
  266          and (expiry if expiry.tzinfo else expiry.replace(tzinfo=UTC)) > now
  267      )
  268      if live_owner:
  269          return
  270      expired_owner = bool(getattr(run, "execution_owner", None) and not live_owner)
  271      if expired_owner:
  272          run.status = "NEEDS_ATTENTION"
  273          run.event_log_complete = False
  274          run.failure_code = "RUN_EXECUTION_LEASE_EXPIRED"
  275          run.execution_owner = None
  276          run.execution_lease_expires_at = None
  277      if (stale or expired_owner) and any(a.execution_status == "CLAIMED" for a in all_approvals):
  278          for approval in all_approvals:
  279              if approval.execution_status == "CLAIMED":
  280                  approval.execution_status = "UNKNOWN_OUTCOME"
  281                  approval.failure_code = "ACTION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN"
  282          run.status = "NEEDS_ATTENTION"
  283          run.failure_code = "ACTION_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED"
  284          run.resume_pending = False
  285          run.event_log_complete = False
  286          return
  287      if run.status == "RUNNING" and pending:
  288          if not checkpoint_exists:
  289              run.status = "NEEDS_ATTENTION"
  290              run.failure_code = "APPROVAL_CHECKPOINT_MISSING"
  291          else:
  292              run.status = "WAITING_APPROVAL"
  293      if run.status == "RUNNING" and stale and not checkpoint_exists:
  294          # No pending approval, no checkpoint, and no progress for longer than
  295          # the zombie threshold: nothing can resume this run, so it must not
  296          # stay RUNNING (and keep stream followers polling) forever.
  297          run.status = "NEEDS_ATTENTION"
  298          run.failure_code = "RUN_CHECKPOINT_MISSING"
  299      if run.status == "WAITING_APPROVAL" and not checkpoint_exists:
  300          run.status = "NEEDS_ATTENTION"
  301          run.failure_code = "APPROVAL_CHECKPOINT_MISSING"
  302      if run.status == "CANCEL_REQUESTED" and any(
  303          approval.execution_status in {"CLAIMED", "UNKNOWN_OUTCOME"} for approval in all_approvals
  304      ):
  305          run.status = "NEEDS_ATTENTION"
  306          run.failure_code = "ACTION_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED"
  307      elif run.status == "CANCEL_REQUESTED":
  308          run.status = "CANCELLED"
  309          run.failure_code = None
  310      if run.status == "WAITING_APPROVAL" and checkpoint_exists and not pending:
  311          active = getattr(run, "waiting_approval_id", None)
  312          if any(
  313              a.decision_status != "PENDING" and (active is None or a.id == active)
  314              for a in all_approvals
  315          ):
  316              run.resume_pending = True
  317      if run.status != before_status:
  318          run.event_log_complete = False
